mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT keep edging up from their current depressed levels, weekday out-of-home activity will continue to rebuild and lift retail visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise versus the prior 28-day mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both increase for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued rise in RESIDENTIAL time signals home-staying intensity that suppresses discretionary trips, so retail-and-recreation mobility will fall further over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC turns up or exceeds its last 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated or increases further.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS recover sharply from a weak level, they can substitute for mall and dining trips and pull leisure demand away from retail for about one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 8 points week-on-week from a negative baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the week after a PARKS jump of more than 8 points, rather than softening.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT stays below WORKPLACES by a wide margin, commuting is not normalizing and retail recovery lags; once the gap narrows, retail should improve over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains at least 2 points more negative than WORKPLACES for two straight weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve after the TRANSIT-WORKPLACES gap narrows below 2 points for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM is a leading sign that household errand traffic is normalizing, which should spill over into more retail-and-recreation visits within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 14 days despite a continued rise in GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL and WORKPLACES move in opposite directions, daytime substitution toward home-based activity dominates and retail mobility weakens over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and WORKPLACES fails to recover.

mechanism_narrative: A quick upswing in PARKS alongside a flat or weak TRANSIT signal marks weather-driven outdoor substitution, which suppresses retail visits for one week before normal behavior returns.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points while TRANSIT does not rise by more than 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not soften in the week after a PARKS surge that is not matched by TRANSIT growth.

mechanism_narrative: Under ongoing restrictions, retail recovery depends on simultaneous easing in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES; if both remain near current troughs, retail stays below its prior four-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds its last 28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain near their current negative levels.
